answer: Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 3 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. Because the rationale is hashed into the marble record and indexed in the opal history, the copper audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 185 aliases as a result needs 185 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
